blind.description: A classic dark iron ball and chain comprising a solid spherical weight, a short chain of interlocking oval links, and an open C-shaped ankle cuff/shackle. The surfaces are solid, continuous, and textured like weathered dark cast iron with subtle metallic sheen. It rests directly on the ground with no base or plinth.
blind.from_above: Seen from directly above, it resembles an aligned barbell or key-like shape: a solid circular sphere on the left connected via two interlocking chain links to an open circular shackle cuff on the right.
blind.height_vs_figure: Rests flat on the floor; the ball reaches about 8-10 inches tall (roughly one-seventh the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and spans about 2 feet in total length.

notes: Chain and shackle are laid out straight rather than curved, giving a narrower footprint than catalog proportion
footprint proportion 2.07x off the catalog (1.7 x 0.6 ft)
underside: the mesh's middle is not over what touches the floor (leaning or cantilevered)
